params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Shen''' manifests a {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} that he can control with his abilities.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Shen}} ability casts grant him a {{tip|shield}} based on {{as|his '''bonus''' health}} for a short time. If he affects at least one other {{tip|champion}} with an ability, ''Ki Barrier's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After completing an {{tip|champion ability|ability's}} effects, '''Shen''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|47 + (120-47)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 13% '''bonus''' health)}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. If '''Shen''' affects at least one other {{tip|champion}} with an ability, ''Ki Barrier's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 8 for 18; then +0.125*x for 2|formula=4 + 4 / 17 * (level - 1) until level 18, then +0.125 per level}} seconds.
params.description2: '''Shen''' manifests a {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} that he can control with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' and ''{{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}}''.
params.notes:
* The {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} spawns with '''Shen''', teleports closer to him if he gets too far away, and instantly blinks to him if he uses any global {{tip|blink}} ({{si|Teleport}}, {{si|Recall}}, or {{ai|Stand United|Shen}}). It will also dissappear if '''Shen''' dies and reappear upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
* Enemies see an arrow pointing from '''Shen''' to the location of his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} even if it is not visible.
* {{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}} will grant the shield if the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} reaches '''Shen'''. If it is stopped, no shield is granted. It will grant the cooldown reduction upon hitting an enemy champion.
* {{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} will grant the shield and/or the cooldown reduction after the protective zone disappears. It does not need to block attacks to trigger the cooldown reduction, just touch an ally champion at any point of the duration.
* {{ai|Shadow Dash|Shen}} will grant the shield when the dash ends. It will grant the cooldown reduction upon hitting an enemy champion.
** If the dash is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, the shield will instead be received the moment the {{tip|crowd control}} source is applied, before damage calculation (if any).
* {{ai|Stand United|Shen}} will give the shield and/or the cooldown reduction upon completing the channel.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shen}} recalls his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} to his location, which shortly {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit while moving away from him.
params.blurb2: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next three basic attacks within a period to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb3: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the empowerment is enhanced and additionally grants him {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' recalls his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} to him. Enemy champions hit by the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} along its path are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for the next 2 seconds while moving away from '''Shen'''.
params.description2: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. Against {{tip|structures}}, only the flat damage portion is applied.
params.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Magic Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*3 to 4*3}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|4.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
params.description3: If the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal {{ccs|{{as|'''increased bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and additionally grant '''Shen''' {{sti|as|{{as|50% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Increased Bonus Damage|{{pp|10 to 40 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}|Total Increased Damage|{{pp|10*3 to 40*3 for 6|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*3 to 7*3}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)|health}}}}
params.description4: Empowered attacks against {{tip|monsters}} deal 100% '''bonus''' damage, but their '''total''' damage is capped.
params.notes:
* The {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} will track '''Shen''' as it is traveling to him, following his movements if he changes locations while the blade is in-flight.
* The {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} will stop in place upon colliding with {{tip|projectile|projectile-intercepting}} effects. If this occurs, '''Shen''' will not gain the empowered attacks as the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} failed to complete its travel to him.
* When it is recalled, the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} also checks for units whose {{tip|gameplay radius}} it overlaps with (equal to a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 0 radius check) before flying off, allowing it to hit enemies whose center is behind the missile origin.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shen}} primes his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}}, creating an area around it. After a short time, or when '''Shen''' or allied champions enter the area, the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} briefly erupts a protective zone that {{tip|block|blocks}} enemy basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' primes his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}}, creating an area around it. After 2 seconds, or when '''Shen''' or an allied champion enters the area, the {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} generates a protective zone for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, {{tip|block|blocking}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area.
params.notes:
* ''Spirit's Refuge's'' protective zone can be moved while active if '''Shen''' uses {{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}.
* ''Spirit's Refuge'' cannot be ranked up at [[Experience (champion)|Level]] 1.
* ''Spirit's Refuge'' will also block damage from all abilities that use {{tip|basic damage}} ({{ai|Lunge|Fiora}}, {{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}, {{ai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo}}).
* Allied {{tip|clone|clones}} are also considered champions for this ability.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' or ''Shadow Dash'' will restore {{sti|{{as|energy}}}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shen}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, briefly {{tip|taunt|taunting}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} he passes through and dealing {{as|physical damage}} based on {{as|his '''bonus''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Dealing damage with ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}'' or ''Shadow Dash'' restores {{sti|energy|{{as|{{pp|30 to 50 for 3|1;4;12}} energy}}}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} he passes through and {{tip|taunt|taunting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}} and {{ai|Spirit's Refuge|Shen}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.collision radius: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|60|Dash collision radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|150|Lollipop at end of dash}}}}
params.notes:
* Casting {{si|Flash}} during ''Shadow Dash'' will end the dash prematurely, but the end-of-dash collision check will hit enemies at the [[blink|blink's]] location still.
** This still cannot affect the same enemy more than once.
* The energy restore from ''Shadow Dash'' may only occur once.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shen}} {{tip|channels}} for a short time, {{tip|shield|shielding}} the target allied champion for a few seconds. The {{sti|shield}} is based on {{as|his '''bonus''' health}} and increases based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: Upon completing the channel, '''Shen''' and his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} {{tip|blink}} to the target ally, placed between them and the nearest enemy champion.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shen''' focuses his will, {{ccib|Stand United Minimap.png}} {{tip|channel|channeling|noimg=true}} for 3 seconds and granting the target allied champion a {{tip|shield}} for 5 seconds at the time of cast, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 60 for 7|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Minimum Shield Strength|{{ap|120 to 320}} {{as|(+ 135% AP)}} {{as|(+ 15% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Maximum Shield Strength|{{ap|120*1.6 to 320*1.6}} {{as|(+ 216% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*1.6}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description2: Upon completing the channel, '''Shen''' and his {{as|Spirit Blade|buzzword}} {{tip|blink}} to the target ally's location, placed between them and the nearest enemy champion. '''Shen''' also {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroys}} any {{tip|projectiles}} targeting him at the time of completion.
params.notes:
* Due to several character stats needing to be recalculated each time a character spawns, casting ''Stand United'' immediately upon respawning will cause its cooldown to be unaffected by ability haste, and the shielding will not be increased by '''Shen's''' {{as|ability power}}, but will be increased by his {{as|'''bonus''' maximum health}}. {{bug}}
* ''Stand United'' can target allies via the [[Map (League of Legends)|mini map]] or on their portraits or by using the {{sbc|F2 - F5}} keys (none of this can be done if '''Shen''' is affected by {{tip|nearsight}} or his target is {{tip|untargetable}}).
* '''Shen''' will turn to face towards his target ally at the start of the channel.
** If the target is {{tip|stealth|stealthed}}, enemies could, in theory, use this to estimate their location.
* '''Shen''' will channel so long as his target is alive (even if the granted shield is broken). If his target dies, the channel is canceled and ''Stand United'' goes on full cooldown.
** {{tip|Interrupt|Interrupting}} ''Stand United's'' channel will not remove the shield prematurely.
* The target's screen will glow purple to telegraph that '''Shen''' has targeted them with ''Stand United''.
** It will change back when the channel ends.
* '''Shen''' finds the nearest visible enemy champion within 2000 range from the ally or the nearest invisible champion within 600 range to place himself 175 units from his ally towards that enemy.
* ''Stand United'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 100 units.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate at the end of ''Stand United's'' {{tip|channel}}.
